observation: Synthetic usability reports indicate that people better understood the privacy boundary when the first choice was Keep this private and the Field Note option appeared as a separate deliberate action rather than a preselected sharing checkbox.
contexts: Participants reviewed mock content rather than real therapy transcripts.
confounders: The revised version also used shorter consent language.
unknowns: The reports are synthetic examples, not participant evidence.
The result may not generalize to mobile screens.
No real sensitive disclosure was used.
